decisions.why: all named categories (Luxaprint Shellac/3D Shell/3D Mould, Detax Softwear, Printers, Scanners, PRO PLAS, Freeprint Shell/Mould, Pico PLAS) are 3D-printing systems, resins and mould-design software for manufacturing custom hearing-aid earmoulds/shells — a coherent single product class; new type added under audiology 26/08/2026 on Lou's decision, since none of the existing types (impl/diag/serv/hear/acc) cover lab/manufacturing equipment
